lastCompletedStory.title: Dedupe inline notifyOrchestrator blocks in loop.ts behind private helpers and lower the file-size ceiling

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-215) is DONE and committed (2e3d9a6). The operator amendment on 2026-07-08 unblocked the 10-session deadlock: AC4 was relaxed to permit deleting the superseded CAM-94 'AC7' static source-grep test in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts, since the AC1-3 dedup structurally collapses the formatWorkerReportSummary( call-site count in loop.ts from 3 to 1 (mutually exclusive with the old pinned count==3 assertion). This session deleted that test block (plus its now-unused readFileSync import), then discovered a SECOND latent defect while running the full quality spine: the file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/supervisor/loop.ts had been set to 1927 by an earlier session using `wc -l`, but scripts/check-file-sizes.ts measures via `content.split('\n').length`, which is one higher (1928) on any file ending with a trailing newline (confirmed by cross-checking several other existing budget entries: all match split-length, not wc -l). Corrected the ceiling to 1928 and updated the _ref note; `bun run check:all` now passes clean (typecheck/test/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity all ok, 3748 tests pass). A new durable pattern for this off-by-one class should be considered for scripts/cam/patterns.md by whichever session next touches file-size-budget.json (not added this session to keep the diff focused on the story itself). prd.json currently contains only this one user story, now passes:true; check whether the operator has queued a next PRD/story before dispatching another implementer.
